vulnerability.name: Spring Framework Class Property RCE (Spring4Shell)
vulnerability.author: Thomas Shaw
vulnerability.description: This module deploys a vulnerable Spring MVC web application (Spring Framework 5.3.17) as a WAR on Apache Tomcat 8.5.77, reachable on port 8080. A @GetMapping controller binds request parameters onto a plain Java object, which is the sink for CVE-2022-22965 (Spring4Shell). On JDK 9+ the data binder exposes the object's class loader via the class.module.classLoader property path. An unauthenticated attacker walks class.module.classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.* to reconfigure Tomcat's AccessLogValve so that request data is written as a JSP into the web root, then requests that JSP to run arbitrary commands as the Tomcat service user (an unprivileged account). Tomcat 8.5.77 predates the 8.5.78 hardening that blocks this AccessLogValve write, and JDK 9+ (Debian 12 ships OpenJDK 17) provides the java.lang.Module class the property path needs. The Metasploit module exploit/multi/http/spring_framework_rce_spring4shell automates this.
vulnerability.hint: A Spring MVC page echoes the name and age you pass it; the same data binding reaches the server's class loader on JDK 9+.
vulnerability.solution: Spring Framework 5.3.0-5.3.17 / 5.2.0-5.2.19 on JDK 9+ binds request parameters to the class loader (CVE-2022-22965); abuse the class.module.classLoader path to write a JSP webshell via Tomcat's AccessLogValve and gain code execution as the Tomcat user.
